name: Brownfield Scan
description: A full-bleed read-only Brownfield acquisition surface with a large repository URL control, staged scan progress, evidence cards, score ring, fallback warnings, and next-command rail.

hosted-repo-scan.description: Centered full-bleed hero that collapses into an evidence report after a public GitHub repo or GitHub Pages URL is submitted.

slots.hero: Full-bleed centered headline, supporting copy, safety guarantee chips, and repository URL form.
slots.scan-control: Large d-control URL input paired with a primary d-interactive submit action.
slots.progress: Staged, polite live-region progress copy with no source-execution reassurance.
slots.verdict: Prominent d-card report summary with a d-conic-ring confidence score.
slots.evidence-grid: Responsive d-card panels for repository evidence, published-site evidence, route map, styling intelligence, findings, and next commands.

slots.hero: Full-bleed centered headline, supporting copy, safety guarantee chips, and repository URL form.
slots.report: Responsive evidence report composed from d-card, d-label, d-conic-ring, and command controls.

visual_brief: The scan surface should feel more like a precise product instrument than a registry catalog page: immersive full-bleed Luminarum background, centered hero, calm safety chips, a generous input dock, and report cards with unmistakable internal spacing.

composition.desktop: full-bleed-hero -> compact-scan-dock -> verdict + metrics -> two-up evidence panels -> findings grid -> command rail
composition.mobile: stacked hero -> full-width input/button -> single-column evidence cards -> compact command rail

motion.entrance: Hero content fades and rises subtly on mount.
motion.scan: Progress copy rotates while the API runs; do not show fake browser screenshots in v1.
motion.report: Cards stagger upward once the report is available; score ring pops after verdict.

mobile.notes: The input and button stack vertically, all cards keep at least 1rem internal padding, and long repository paths wrap without horizontal overflow.

desktop.notes: The background is full-bleed while report content is constrained only for readability.

keyboard: URL input is reachable before the submit button.
Progress and report updates use polite live regions.
Command copy buttons expose visible copied state.
accessibility.focus_management: Return focus to the scan form after validation errors; keep report content in document order after submit.
